title: Hope is not a method (2nd revision)
creator_credit: Planned Parenthood Center of Syracuse and Wexler Film Productions
brief_description: Cites and describes nine contraceptive methods with anatomically explicit diagrams. States the advantages of withdrawal, rhythm, spermicidal chemicals, the cap, the condom, the diaphragm, the pill, the IUD and sterilization.
